notes.title: Official update record
notes.content:
3.0.6
"Treasure of abyss" West Sea chapter is released! 

I made this game and it took me a year and a half. Now that the game has completed the three seas of East, South and West, I feel incredible!
As a lonely personal game author, I am very grateful to you for your long-term support and love, so that I can stick to this little ideal.
Remember the beginning of the mind, in order to have a good ending.
I wish everyone a happy life.

2.1.0
1. Fixed a minor problem in the final battle of the South  Sea chapter.
2. Added the ten-open function of the treasure chest.

2.0.7
1. Increased the chances of obtaining treasure chests and high-grade fish in fishing.
2. Fixed the bug that appeared after using the returning props in the desert city.
3. Fixed inaccurate item icons.

2.0.6
1. Fixed some tasks stuck.
2, repaired the fate between the card.
3. Fixed the effect of the fascinating and fragrant in the South Sea region.

notes.title: 更新说明
notes.content:
1.9.99a
1. Repair the item and skill description and change the description of the enhanced ceiling to the description on the equipment.
2. Correct the effect of the savage and scent of the singer to perform the hunting elite.
3. Increase the continuous opening effect of the mysterious treasure chest.
4. When we increase the bar draw and fight with the treasure chest monster, our escape function.
5. Fix the equipment explosion rate in the novice stage.
6. Revise the rating requirements of the Kingdom Treasure, Lost City and Slim King.
7, add emphasis on the looting of the treasure house, the guidance of the Claudia.
8, change the Nancy combat factor · precision shooting, point silver, continuous shooting and combat factor · blast scattering anger consumption.
==================================
1.9.99
1. Add new game guides.
2, modify the description of the equipment and skills (if you find something wrong, please leave a message in the forum).
3. Fix the unknown problem caused by the rendering engine.
4, cancel the mysterious weapons will seal the Nancy shooting skills set.
5. Delete the compensation package and add the strengthening stone to the treasure chest of Guangchen's home.
=========================================================== ===
1.9.98d
1. Increase the reinforcement function of the treasure, and strengthen the material in the mysterious treasure chest of the seabed.
2. Increase the “ten fishing” function of fishing.
3, increase the frame number mode in the settings, Caton's partner can try to switch.
4. Fixed some feedback from partners.
=========================================================== ===
1.9.98c
1、修复东明镇旅店的恢复效果与沃特医生的治疗效果。
2、修复解除负面状态的效果。
3、怪鸠魔瞳王在MP耗尽后，则判定为战斗胜利。（酒吧的怪鸠王实力稍弱，没有此功能）
=====================================================
1.9.98b
1、完善存档功能。
2、完善漂流瓶任务，取消了前提获取条件。
3、提升长杆加钩子获取漂流瓶的几率与短杆加钩子获取神秘宝箱的几率。
=====================================================
1.9.98更新
1、在宝藏中提升了金钱奖励。
2、加入金钱补偿礼包。
=====================================================
1.9.97更新
1、修正了塞拉南部洞穴小地图的问题。
2、修正了漂流瓶描述问题。
3、为主线剧情与漂流瓶任务加入了经验奖励。
4、加入了补偿礼包。
=====================================================
1.9.96更新
1、降低鬣狗触发“腰斩”的难度。
=====================================================
1.9.95更新
1、优化自动存档，玩家无法自行覆盖存档位置，避免坏档。
=====================================================
1.9.93更新
1、加入了鬣狗二阶段“腰斩”功能。
=====================================================
1.9.92更新
1、修正一些技能的描述。
2、调整物品最大携带数量为999。
3、修正南希缠斗九连技的问题。
4、修正“精灵之核”带有的无敌效果。
5、添加装备套装描述属性的颜色变化。
6、修正一些不合理的Bug。
7、闭关填海，短期内不会更新了。
=====================================================
1.9.91更新
非常抱歉，由于我的更新，造成了塔塔村北方洞窟与曼巴战斗事件的严重错误，为各位伙伴带去了损失。
现在已经修复，并在塔塔村光臣的家中投放了补偿宝箱，开启即可获得补偿金币与道具。
=====================================================
1.9.9更新
1、改变南希的奥义特殊技触发方式，加快普通战斗节奏。
2、为南希增加疾动指挥技能。
3、删除苗路的“群体恢复术”，并将持续恢复的效果添加在“群体治疗术”之后。
4、强化苗路防御屏障，增加魔法防御效果。
5、医院可以购买高级别恢复药水。
6、在市场增加高级食物，杂货摊增加“驱邪药草”
7、修正了“精灵之核”无敌效果。
*暂时不会有更新了，嗯……偶尔会有小更新吧，我要闭关填海了。
=====================================================
1.9.8更新
1、神秘装备可卖。
2、修正了医院治疗和旅店住宿的体力恢复量。
3、变改了战斗中连击的失血效果，加入了状态提示。
4、下次将更新一些对战斗节奏有力的内容，例如南希的特殊技的改变。或许会取消比较鸡肋的自动存档。
=====================================================
1.9.7更新
1、修正了抢夺宝库后登船无法下船的Bug。
=====================================================
1.9.6更新
1、修正了王都塞拉南部左侧海岸的港口问题，预防引起后续的Bug。
2、修正了塔塔村墨山治疗时的治疗量。
